name: Refactor in small steps

problemSignals.description: Concrete structural smells indicate a bounded refactoring opportunity.
Control flow or data flow is unnecessarily difficult to understand or verify.
Responsibilities or dependencies cross a declared boundary without a clear contract.

requiredEvidence.description: A runnable baseline proving the behavior of the bounded scope before transformation.
Explicit file, symbol, or responsibility limits for one refactoring slice.
Comparable structural observations showing what changed and what remains.

assumptions: The current behavior has an executable baseline
One transformation can be applied without combining migration or behavior changes
Structural evidence can be collected before and after the slice

deterministicSteps.action: Run and retain the executable behavior baseline for the bounded scope before editing.
Apply exactly one structural transformation within the declared scope, with no behavior-changing migration.
Compare before and after structure, rerun the behavior proof, and record remaining smells or boundary erosion.

outputs.description: One bounded structural transformation; no behavior-changing migration is covered.
Executable evidence that the bounded behavior remains unchanged.
Before/after structural delta and explicitly remaining smells or boundary erosion.

whenAll: The baseline is executable and passes before and after
Only one bounded transformation was applied
Structural delta and residual smells are recorded
Behavior proof covers the core scope
Structural evidence is partial or residual complexity remains
The changed scope or transformation cannot be bounded
Behavior and structure cannot be compared

drivers: Number of residual smells requiring later slices

contraindications: The baseline is not executable or does not cover the scope
The change requires a behavior-changing migration
Multiple coupled transformations cannot be separated safely

contract: Compare declared before and after structure
Report a bounded delta without selecting or executing a migration

outOfScope: Large rewrites without an executable baseline
